title: MatlabAppClassDesigner R2024a component documentation transcript
description: Development-only transcript of public MATLAB component documentation and release audit decisions. Schema version 3 represents one concrete component variant per file. It is not the runtime component catalog and does not authorize editing or Safe Preview application.

id.description: Stable identifier for this concrete component variant, independent of its MATLAB factory name.

factory.description: MATLAB factory function used to construct this variant.

creationArguments.description: Documented positional factory arguments that distinguish this variant. An empty array denotes the factory default.

declaredType.description: Concrete public MATLAB class documented for this variant.

sources.description: Release-fixed MathWorks documentation pages used for this one variant.

documentationCategories.description: Official property categories in source-page order. Categories are defined separately so properties remain flat and composable.

properties.description: Public properties in source-page order. Each property references exactly one documented category.

url.description: Must be a release-fixed R2024a MathWorks documentation URL.

id.description: Stable local identifier used by properties in this file.

displayName.description: Category heading transcribed from the official property page.

order.description: One-based appearance order on the official property page.

categoryId.description: Identifier of this property's official documentation category.

order.description: One-based appearance order within its documentation category.

documentedDefault.description: Default-value text transcribed from the official heading, when supplied.

documentedAcceptedValues.description: Accepted-value text transcribed from the official heading, excluding documentedDefault.

documentedReadOnly.description: Present only when the official page explicitly marks the property read-only.

runtimeSetAccess.description: Target-release meta.property SetAccess observation. This supporting evidence does not override documentedReadOnly.

runtimeObservations.description: Target-release hidden-fixture observations retained separately from authoritative documentation facts.

valueContract.description: Normalized semantic value contract. Original documentation text remains in documentedAcceptedValues.

affectsDisplay.description: Whether changing this property can affect the visual or interactive result Safe Preview is intended to represent.

previewPolicy.description: Safe Preview assignment policy, independent of editability.

requiredEditor.description: Semantic editor requirement for an editable property; this does not assert adapter implementation status.

disposition.description: Initial product disposition, independent of current adapter availability.

matlabClasses.description: Normalized accepted MATLAB value classes. any and unknown are audit markers rather than MATLAB class names.

fixedLength.description: Required element count when shape is fixedLengthVector.

minimum.description: Inclusive numeric lower bound when documented.

maximum.description: Inclusive numeric upper bound when documented.

exclusiveMinimum.description: Whether the documented numeric lower bound is exclusive.

exclusiveMaximum.description: Whether the documented numeric upper bound is exclusive.

integer.description: Whether the documented numeric contract requires integer values.

allowsInfinity.description: Whether the documented numeric contract permits positive or negative infinity.

orientation.description: Documented orientation when vector orientation is significant.

allowsNaT.description: Whether a datetime contract admits NaT independently of empty-array support.

normalization.description: Documented or target-runtime canonical form relevant to safe editing.

values.description: Complete finite choices for an enum contract, normalized without MATLAB literal quotes. Omit when the documentation does not establish a complete finite set.
